comment: Longobardi is an awesome teacher, she's genuinely interested in making sure her students understand the material. she is always willing to move around deadlines to accommodate students. she has a good sense of humor, and always keeps the class interesting. this class is a ton of work, but completely worth it

An eloquent speaker, a brilliant intellect, and a generous spirit.  Remarkably gifted at taking complex concepts and explaining them to even to the most un-musically inclined student.  As fair as any teacher could possibly be.  Plus she is easily the hottest teacher on the Richmond campus.  Highly recommended.
dr. longobardi is a great teacher and really cares about what students have to say. class discussions mattered a lot to her and were fun because she listened.
